review_mode: AST parse, source/hash and control-flow review only; script not imported/executed. No auth/token acquisition, network, UI, cache or root-tool modification.

resolved_finding.before: Raw ZIP-name uniqueness permits a/b versus a//b or a/./b to overwrite the same destination.
resolved_finding.after: Path-normalized destination keys are NFC-normalized and casefolded; every key must be unique before extractall.

checks.download_identity: Exactly one nonexpired named API artifact; API record/run retained in sibling receipt.
checks.digest_before_use: Actual downloaded ZIP bytes SHA256 computed before opening/extracting ZIP or deleting it. API digest must match strict sha256 format and actual bytes when present.
checks.mismatch: Initial receipt already preserves API digest and actual ZIP digest. Equality failure precedes destination creation/extraction/unlink; ZIP remains.
checks.missing_digest: api_digest_verified remains false; successful download receipt explicitly says API digest unavailable. No API verification claimed.
checks.bounds: API advertised archive size and sum of declared expanded member sizes each strictly below100MiB.
checks.zip_paths: Absolute paths/.. rejected; resolved destination must remain a descendant. Literal names and normalized NFC/casefold targets unique.
checks.zip_types: Only unspecified/regular/directory Unix type accepted; symlink and other special types rejected before extraction.
checks.success_receipt: Successful extraction precedes archive unlink; sibling receipt persists digest, API snapshot, member count, normalized-target check and deletion flag.

limits: Static preflight only. A real future ZIP/download has not been exercised by this review.
Uses ordinary Python with assertions enabled and an owned fresh destination namespace without concurrent writers.
Advertised archive-size gate is from API; expanded-size gate uses ZIP metadata. This is not a new transport/decompression fuzz audit.
Archive validation/extraction errors may leave a fresh empty/partial destination and the retained ZIP; final success/deletion is not claimed.
If extraction fails after a matching digest, the initial receipt may still have api_digest_verified=false; this underclaims, rather than asserting a completed operation.
No historical cohort outer-ZIP digest verification is added or backfilled.
